item.title: 訛稱配碼零出資強抽利息近四萬 爆爭執驚動保安3內地漢被捕
item.description:
>
訛稱配碼零出資強抽利息近四萬 三名內地男子涉嫌於澳門路氹區娛樂場從事不法借貸，向一名內地中年賭客訛稱實施「配碼」賭博，卻在未出資的情況下強行抽取高達39,000港元利息。雙方隨後因資金協議交涉破裂爆發激烈爭執，驚動現場保安報案，司警到場將三名嫌疑人當場拘捕。 涉案的三名內地居民分別為40歲魏姓、38歲李姓及42歲方姓男子，均報稱無業。司警已依法對3人落案起訴「為賭博的不法借貸」罪，案件已移送檢察院偵辦。 案情顯示，事發於本月20日凌晨，事主於路氹區某娛樂場內結識涉案嫌犯。雙方當時約定實施「配碼」賭博，協議由事主與嫌犯各自出資15萬港元作為賭博本金，並約定百家樂每局獲勝需抽取兩成利息。協議達成後，事主先行使用屬於自己的15萬港元本金進行投注。期間，涉案李某負責管理籌碼及抽傭，並隨後將籌碼轉交予魏某與方某。然而，事主在投注過程中，一直未見3名嫌犯按照協議拿出承諾的15萬港元資金。嫌犯在「零出資」的情況下，竟已從事主處累計抽取了39,000港元的利息。 事主發現受騙後隨即與三名嫌犯理論，雙方在現場爆發激烈爭執，場內保安見狀隨即報警處理。司警接報趕抵現場接手調查，當場揭發這宗涉嫌配碼及不法借貸的案件，並將3名涉案男子拘捕。行動中，警方在3人身上共扣查了3部手機及9,000港元籌碼，全案現已交由檢察院跟進偵辦。

item.title: Major Investment Banks Cut Macau Casino Earnings Forecasts as Tighter Capital Controls Strain High-End Demand
item.description:
>
Major Investment Banks Cut Macau Casino Earnings Forecasts as Tighter Capital Controls Strain High-End Demand Major international investment banks, including HSBC and Citi, have downgraded industry forecasts for the Macau gaming market, which is showing signs of weakness, with demand for high-end gaming continuing to face significant pressure. According to the latest research report by HSBC, high-end gaming demand in Macau remains under pressure due to China’s offshore trust tax policies and tighter capital controls. Gross gaming revenue (GGR) in Macau declined by 4% year-on-year in the third quarter of this year. HSBC projects that the year-on-year GGR decline will widen to 3% in the fourth quarter, with VIP gaming revenue expected to drop sharply by 28%. Consequently, the bank lowered its industry EBITDA forecasts for 2026 to 2028 by 3% to 4%, while reducing target prices for Macau gaming stocks by an average of 8%. Regarding individual operator performance, HSBC highlighted that Galaxy Entertainment and Sands China outperformed peers driven by market share expansion, with Q3 EBITDA projected to increase by 5% and 22% quarter-on-quarter, respectively. MGM China is expected to post stable Q3 EBITDA quarter-on-quarter. In contrast, Melco Resorts & Entertainment, Wynn Macau, and SJM Holdings are expected to lose market share, with Q3 EBITDA projected to drop between 2% and 14% quarter-on-quarter. Meanwhile, a research report from Citi indicated that Macau’s GGR reached approximately MOP 14.1 billion in the first 19 days of October (representing a daily average GGR of around MOP 613 million). Citi maintained its full-month GGR forecast of MOP 23 billion, representing a 5% year-on-year decline. The bank noted that as the 90-day grace period for mainland China’s offshore trust tax declarations expires on October 22, combined with potential support from several major concerts, GGR trends may improve in the period ahead.

item.title: 金沙中國連續17年資助平安通 捐款24萬推動長幼共融
item.description:
>
金沙中國連續17年資助平安通 由澳門街總轄下「平安通」呼援服務中心及藝駿中心合辦、金沙中國贊助的「2026金沙中國慈善捐贈暨『長幼愛共融』系列活動啟動禮」於上17日舉行。金沙向「街坊總會平安通慈善基金」捐贈24萬澳門元，這已是金沙連續第17年支持「平安通」及相關長者關愛項目，累計惠及近29,000名長者。是次捐款將用於資助850名經濟困難的長者使用「平安通」，並持續支援「平安通維修特工隊」及「千歲剪」兩項延伸關愛計劃。 金沙中國企業傳訊及社會事務副總裁江慧賢向澳門街總理事長陳家良送交捐款支票 「平安通維修特工隊」透過培訓義工掌握水電維修技能，至今已培育逾280名學員，為近4,500名長者提供上門維修服務，金沙每月亦會派出專業技能義工參與其中；而專為青年義工提供理髮培訓的「千歲剪」計劃，至今已培訓435位義工，累計為3,700名長者提供義剪服務。 「長幼愛共融」系列活動活動當天吸引約200名長者及青年義工參與，來自澳門多所中學的學生在金沙中國關懷大使協助下，與長者共同製作了200個艾草香囊，現場亦安排「千歲剪」學員提供即場義剪，場面溫馨熱鬧。 金沙中國有限公司行政副主席王英偉表示，金沙與街總攜手合作17載，持續為長者提供切實支援，並透過系列項目共同參與社區服務，在關愛長者的同時促進跨代互動與互助精神。街總理事長陳家良感謝金沙的長期支持，並指出未來「平安通」將配合特區政府安老政策，結合智慧科技，助力長者安享晚年。

item.title: Chinese Mainland Internet Users Get Redirected to Gambling Websites Due to Overseas Cyberattacks
item.description:
>
Chinese Mainland Internet Users Get Redirected to Gambling Websites Due to Overseas CyberattacksChinese Mainland Internet Users Get Redirected to Gambling Websites Due to Overseas Cyberattacks Multiple provinces in China have recently experienced incidents where internet users’ network access requests were abnormally redirected to gambling websites, according to a recent security alert issued by China’s National Computer Network Emergency Response Technical Team/Coordination Center (CNCERT).   Investigations reveal that the attackers primarily launched their attacks using overseas Autonomous Systems (AS), resulting in a widespread impact. First, the attackers registered false source address prefixes and sets of Autonomous Systems in the Internet Routing Registry (IRR). By using the Autonomous Systems under their control to announce these fake source address prefixes alongside short paths, they successfully hijacked portion of domestic network traffic in China. Subsequently, after hijacking the traffic, the attackers tampered with the DNS resolution data contained within. Their methods included directly modifying DNS resolution values to point to gambling website addresses, or directing resolution values to malicious DNS servers, ultimately leading users to gambling websites when requesting domain name resolutions.   Through technical measurements and tracking, officials have confirmed that the domain tampering occurred within the overseas Autonomous System AS 402425. This Autonomous System was registered in April 2026 by QOREXA LABS, a US company operating Bitcoin-related businesses, as shown by the information on its official website.   In response to this security threat, CNCERT advises relevant network operators and platforms to strengthen routing filtering and monitoring, promptly clear malicious routes, and sever hijacking links. At the same time, it reminds netizens to use trusted DNS services. If an abnormal webpage redirection occurs, users should not click any buttons or download programs, but should immediately close the webpage and clear their browser cache. Furthermore, users are advised to keep their operating systems and browsers updated while enabling security protections to guard against phishing and malicious attacks.

item.title: Macau Q3 Gaming Revenue Drops 3.7% to MOP 60.41 Billion
item.description:
>
Macau Q3 Gaming Revenue Drops 3.7% to MOP 60.41 Billion Macau’s total gross gaming revenue (GGR) across all categories in the third quarter of 2026 reached MOP 60.41 billion, down slightly by over 1.2% quarter-on-quarter and 3.7% year-on-year, according to the latest data released by Macau’s Gaming Inspection and Coordination Bureau (DICJ).   Cumulative GGR for the first three quarters reached MOP 187.66 billion. Football betting performed exceptionally well during the period, recording MOP 152 million in gross revenue in Q3, which represents a 21% sequential increase and marks a new quarterly high since Q3 2018.   Total gross revenue from games of fortune in Q3 stood at MOP 60.21 billion, dipping by just over 1.3% quarter-on-quarter. Among individual gaming sectors, “VIP Baccarat,” which reflects VIP room earnings, posted gross revenue of MOP 16.9 billion in the third quarter, rebounding 6.3% quarter-on-quarter and accounting for 28% of total GGR. In contrast, “Mass Baccarat,” the largest segment by market share, recorded MOP 33.6 billion in Q3 gross revenue, down 4.4% quarter-on-quarter and representing 55.6% of overall GGR.   Notably, sports betting delivered a standout performance in Q3. Total handle (wagers) for football betting exceeded MOP 1.39 billion, an increase of MOP 14 million quarter-on-quarter. Gross revenue from football betting reached MOP 152 million during the period, surging by 21% quarter-on-quarter to hit its highest single-quarter level since Q3 2018.   Market analysis indicates that Q3 gaming data reflects structural shifts characterized by “hot sports betting, cool mass market, and stable VIP.” The substantial growth in football betting was primarily driven by the event effect of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, hosted by Canada, Mexico, and the United States. As the tournament’s climax (spanning mid-June to mid-July) crossed into the third quarter, it not only fueled a betting frenzy but also boosted hold rates (win rate) for gaming operators, pushing gross profits to an eight-year high.   In contrast, the sequential decline in Mass Baccarat highlights a trend of “more sightseeing, lower spending” among visitors, alongside an overall slowdown in per-capita spending. This was further compounded by a shift in consumer spending toward sports events during the tournament, as well as the seasonal effect of September’s traditional off-peak period. As for the counter-trend rebound in the VIP segment, besides benefiting from a favorable fluctuation in net hold rates, it demonstrates stronger spending resilience among high-end clientele compared to the mass market. Driven by gaming operators’ continued efforts to optimize luxury amenities and exclusive experiences, the sector successfully retained high-net-worth customers.

item.title: 資本管制收緊高端博彩需求受壓 大行削濠賭股目標價8%
item.description:
>
大行將澳門賭業股目標價下調平均8%。 近期澳門博彩市場顯現疲態，特別是高端博彩需求持續受壓，滙豐、花旗等國際大行先後發表最新報告，下調相關行業預測。 滙豐研究報告指出，受內地離岸信託稅務政策及資本管制收緊影響，澳門高端博彩需求持續受壓，今年第三季澳門賭收按年下跌4%，預計第四季賭收按年跌幅擴大至3%，其中貴賓廳賭收料大跌28%。該行將2026至2028年行業EBITDA預測下調3%至4%，濠賭股目標價平均下調8%。 博企表現方面，滙豐指出，銀娛(27)及金沙中國(1928)憑藉市佔擴張，第三季EBITDA料分別按季升5%及22%，跑贏同業。美高梅中國(2282)第三季EBITDA按季料穩定。相反，新濠博亞(MLCO.US)、永利澳門(1128)及澳博(880)料流失市佔，第三季EBITDA料按季跌幅介乎2%至14%。 花旗研究報告則顯示，10月首19天澳門賭收約141億澳門元(日均博彩收入約爲6.13億)，維持全月賭收230億澳門元(按年跌5%)的預測。該行指，隨着內地官方設定的90天離岸信託稅務申報過渡期將於本月22日屆滿，加上多場大型演唱對賭收或有額外支持，期望後續賭收走勢會有所改善。

item.title: 54 Arrested in South Korea for Casino Money Laundering
item.description:
>
54 Arrested in South Korea for Casino Money Laundering54 Arrested in South Korea for Casino Money Laundering South Korean police have smashed a large-scale money laundering operation involving four domestic casinos. A criminal syndicate allegedly laundered 28.7 billion South Korean won (approx. HKD 169 million) obtained from an investment scam targeting 555 victims. The funds were converted into casino chips at venues including Kangwon Land and then redeemed back into cash using “two-way betting” in Baccarat to disguise the origin of the illicit money. Police arrested 54 suspects in total, 14 of whom have been detained and transferred to prosecutors.   According to a report by the South Korean media outlet Chosun Ilbo, the Busan Metropolitan Police Agency announced on the 15th of this month that 54 suspects—including a ringleader in his 50s—were handed over to prosecutors on charges of violating laws such as the Special Act on the Refund of Telecommunications Fraud Damage and the Act on Regulation and Punishment of Concealment of Criminal Proceeds. Fourteen individuals were placed under pre-trial detention, while the remaining 40 were transferred without detention.   Police investigations revealed that between October and December 2025, the syndicate laundered money across four casinos in South Korea, including Kangwon Land—which admits South Korean nationals—as well as several foreigner-only casinos.   The laundered funds originated from an overseas-based investment fraud ring. Enticing victims with promises of high investment returns, the syndicate tricked them into depositing funds through fake investment websites. By manipulating data on these sites to create an illusion of legitimate trading, the group defrauded a total of 555 victims out of 28.7 billion won.   Recruiting Casino VIPs and Foreign Permanent Residents to Launder Money via Two-Way Baccarat Betting Police noted that because South Korean banks enforce strict regulations on large cash withdrawals, the criminal group turned to casinos as an alternative channel for money laundering.   The syndicate recruited casino VIP clients capable of making high-stakes bets, as well as South Korean residents holding foreign permanent residency permits who could access foreigner-only casinos. Roles were divided among members to cover recruitment, management, cash withdrawals, chip exchanges, and fund transport.   To execute the scheme, the group first converted the fraud proceeds into cashier’s checks and exchanged them for casino chips. They then placed two members at Baccarat tables to engage in “two-way betting”—simultaneously wagering on both “Banker” and “Player” to minimize betting losses. After completing a required volume of bets, the remaining chips were converted back into cash, successfully concealing the origin of the fraudulent proceeds.   Police also discovered that the syndicate initially conducted transactions through dedicated casino bank accounts. However, as some of these accounts were frozen, they shifted to transferring funds via cashier’s checks before laundering them through chip exchanges at the casinos.   Cash and Assets Seized; Casinos Urged to Strengthen Oversight on Large Transactions Police stated that 3 of the 54 suspects were already wanted criminals. Among them, the ringleader in his 50s had been wanted since August 2024 for money laundering using mule accounts; he evaded capture by using mobile phones and vehicles registered under other people’s names. Another suspect had been on the run for eight years for similar offenses and was arrested with only about two years remaining before the statute of limitations expired.   During the investigation, police seized approximately 111 million won (approx. HKD 653,000) in cash, luxury goods, and around 50 electronic devices including smartphones and computers. Additionally, the court approved a pre-indictment preservation order on approximately 390 million won (approx. HKD 2.296 million) worth of real estate and other assets owned by the suspects to facilitate future confiscation. Police are currently tracking down the overseas investment fraud syndicate.   The Busan police highlighted that using casino chips to turn illicit funds into clean cash is a noteworthy money laundering tactic. They have advised South Korean casino operators and the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism to enhance monitoring of high-value bets and cash withdrawals to prevent casinos from being exploited by criminal syndicates.

item.title: 司警雷霆行動夜巡路氹娛樂場 截查167人未發現違規
item.description:
>
司警雷霆行動夜巡路氹娛樂場，共截查85男及82女。 為持續預防及打擊各類不法活動、維護澳門公共安全與社會秩序，在澳門警察總局統籌下，澳門司法警察局持續推進「雷霆2026」反罪惡巡查行動。司警局於昨日(20日)晚上10時至今日(21日)凌晨1時，共派25名刑事偵查員，深入路氹區多間娛樂場及周邊區域展開巡查，加強防範及打擊涉及不法匯兌、詐騙及其他與博彩相關的違法犯罪活動。 行動期間，司警偵查人員共截查167名人士，包括85名男子及82名女子。巡查過程未發現任何可疑人士或違法違規行為，亦無人需要被帶返司警局作進一步調查，整體治安狀況良好。 司法警察局表示，未來將繼續密切監察澳門的治安態勢發展，持續採取各項預防及打擊罪案的執法行動，全力維護澳門社會治安穩定，為市民及來澳遊客營造安全宜居的環境。

item.title: 疑食葡京人到會屙嘔發燒 澳大書院聚餐28人食物中毒
item.description:
>
約200人日前在澳門大學滿珍紀念書院聚餐，其中28人胃腸炎不適。(互聯網圖片) 澳門大學滿珍紀念書院日前舉行約200人的聚餐活動後，爆發集體胃腸炎不適事件。澳門市政署接獲衞生局通報，指共有28人用膳後出現發熱、腹痛、腹瀉及嘔吐等症狀，其中一名患者的大便樣本驗出沙門氏菌。市政署高度關注事件，已即時派員前往涉事供應商澳門葡京人酒店調查並抽取樣本化驗，將持續跟進事件。 涉事聚餐由澳門葡京人酒店中央廚房製備餐點，以到會及每位分餐形式供應。菜式包括煎石斑魚柳、燒春雞、柑橘凍芝士蛋糕、煙三文魚藜麥粟米雞蛋沙律等。衞生局根據進食紀錄、潛伏期及症狀分析，研判事件較大可能由細菌性病原體引起。 市政署接報後，已派員前往澳門葡京人酒店進行衞生調查，仔細檢視食品處理流程，並抽取食品及環境樣本作檢驗。市政署呼籲，曾進食相關餐次的受影響人士，若出現不適應盡快就醫，並致電食安專線+853 2833 8181通報。 同時，市政署特別提醒餐飲業界必須嚴格遵守食品衞生規範，按實際需求合理備貨，避免食品因存放過久而變質，並落實保留來貨單據與銷售紀錄；亦提醒市民及高風險人群(如幼童、長者、孕婦及免疫力較弱者)應避免進食生鮮或未煮熟食品，收到餐點後應妥善保存並遵守「熱食熱存，冷食冷存」原則，盡快食用。

item.title: MGM Osaka Expected to Need Up to 3,000 Dealers; “Japan Casino School” to Launch MGM-Certified Course Next Year
item.description:
>
MGM Osaka Expected to Need Up to 3,000 Dealers; "Japan Casino School" to Launch MGM-Certified Course Next Year As Japan’s first casino Integrated Resort (IR), “MGM Osaka,” is expected to open in the autumn of 2030, local efforts to train professional casino personnel are accelerating. The Japan Casino School estimates that the Osaka IR may eventually require around 2,500 to 3,000 dealers, and plans to train approximately 2,000 people before the project opens to meet the anticipated manpower demand.   According to Japanese media reports, the Japan Casino School held a press conference in Osaka on the 15th of this month to announce its partnership with MGM Osaka, the operator of the Osaka IR. In April 2027, the school will launch the “MGM Osaka Certified Course” in Tokyo and Osaka to train future casino dealers for the resort. This is reportedly Japan’s first professional training program certified by a casino operator.   The new curriculum offers 3-month, 6-month, and 1-year programs. Training content includes operational skills for table games such as baccarat and roulette, as well as casino operations, fraud prevention, cash management, foreign languages, and gambling addiction prevention. The school stated that graduates who apply for dealer-related positions at MGM Osaka will, in principle, be exempt from the document screening stage of the recruitment process and can proceed directly to subsequent selection assessments. However, this does not guarantee employment. The course will offer 400 spots each in Tokyo and Osaka, totaling 800 spots, with plans to train approximately 2,000 dealers prior to the opening of the Osaka IR.\   Osaka IR Expected to Need Up to 3,000 Dealers The Osaka IR plans to feature approximately 470 gaming tables and 6,400 electronic gaming machines (such as slot machines). Gaming operations are expected to account for roughly 80% of the entire resort’s revenue. MGM Osaka has not yet announced official recruitment figures for dealers. However, the Japan Casino School noted that based on the number of planned tables and drawing from overseas experiences with 24-hour casino operations, the resort will likely require about 2,500 to 3,000 dealers in total.   The Japan Casino School plans to gradually train around 2,000 professionals across the four academic years from 2027 to 2030 to align with recruitment demands prior to the resort’s opening. The school clarified that the training initiative does not receive financial subsidies from MGM Osaka. At the press conference, Masayoshi Oiwane, Principal of the Japan Casino School, expressed his hope to cultivate professional talent capable of stepping onto the international stage from Osaka, thereby contributing to the success of the Osaka IR.   The Osaka IR is being jointly developed by U.S.-based MGM Resorts International and Japanese financial services group Orix Corporation, alongside other investors, and is scheduled to open in the autumn of 2030.
